audit.whatIsWrong: Every mechanical reference on the page calls Hwei's CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability by that name — his real kit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. The CC combo (Grim Visage/Gaze of the Abyss/Crushing Maw, flagged hardCC) lives on E, Subject: Torment.
audit.why: packet.defects flags that the page never names any real Hwei ability, and enemyKit confirms E is his hardCC slot.
audit.corrected: Replace every 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' reference with 'Subject: Torment (E)'.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] names Nami's E as 'Tidewaller's Blessing'; the real name is Tidecaller's Blessing.
The page never mentions that Hwei's Subject: Serenity (W) can shield to absorb your all-in burst.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags rule shield-absorbs-burst for this matchup — it changes all-in maths and isn't covered anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Add it to breakdown.cooldowns: force his W shield out before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 rows disagree between full phases[].side (Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill) and content win[] (Nami/Nami/Nami/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Nami). The packet's real levelChart matches content exactly.
audit.why: Data-driven packet.levelChart and content.win[] already agree with each other; the full layer is the stale/templated side.
audit.corrected: Move all 7 phases[].side to match win[], with why text grounded in the existing (accurate) content whys[]: Nami wins levels 1-3 and 2+ items on early poke/all-in before Hwei's combo is assembled; Hwei wins levels 4-5-6 once his full spell suite out-ranges Nami's single-target kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles ('Dodge his root behind minions' and 'Eat the root warding'), per lintFindings.
audit.why: Body text should match its own title, not restate a different field.
audit.corrected: Write body text specific to dodging his poke and to warding safely.
